description: Verifies the linear memory arenas used by the zero-allocation hot path: capacity accounting, natural and cache-line alignment, object creation, reset, markers, scoped rewinding, sentinel integrity and exhaustion handling.

checks.label: a new arena is empty with its full capacity
a new arena has no allocations and intact sentinels
a scalar allocation is naturally aligned
a 64-byte aligned allocation honours its alignment
create constructs the object with its initial state
the allocation count and sentinels remain consistent
a 128-byte aligned array honours its alignment
writing the whole allocation does not corrupt the sentinels
a scoped allocation advances the marker
leaving the scope restores the marker
rewinding returns to the initial marker
an allocation beyond capacity returns null
a failed allocation leaves the sentinels intact
